script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for October 10. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
You can't Google directions without entering a destination.  You can't reach a target you haven't set.  Goals are chosen destinations—clarity about what you want.

Vague goals get vague results. 'Do better' offers no direction. 'Increase sales by 10% this quarter' creates a path. Specificity transforms wishes into achievable targets. Clear goals activate your brain's filtering system.  You start noticing relevant opportunities that were always there but invisible.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: You can't hit a target you haven't set.  Knowing what you want is the first step to getting it.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Goal Clarity Exercise - What Do You Actually Want?.

Here's your activity: Pick one thing you 'want.' Now make it specific: What exactly? By when? How will you measure it? How will you know you've arrived? Transform a wish into a goal you can actually pursue. This helps you convert vague wishes into specific goals.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about deciding what you want can be applied to goal clarity exercise - what do you actually want?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
